run_wav2vec_asr: run Wav2vecASR module to transcribe audio files from a manifest into text using a Wav2Vec encoder model
load_model_and_task: load a Wav2Vec encoder model and ASR task from a checkpoint file for speech recognition inference
infer_batch_audio: perform batch inference on audio waveforms to generate transcribed sentences using a Wav2Vec model and decoder
generate_sentences_from_hypos: extract transcribed sentences from decoded hypotheses by joining words or post-processing tokens
create_asr_config: create an ASRConfig dataclass to configure Wav2Vec ASR with shards, encoder model path, and runtime requirements
